summary: Round 6 — verified the three EAS-Android/deployment blocker fixes. 26/26 tests PASS. PNG regression: all 14 .png files under /app/frontend/assets/ (10 fixed + 4 pre-existing partial-react-logo / react-logo / react-logo@2x / react-logo@3x / app-image) start with the PNG magic bytes, load through Pillow as format='PNG', and pass verify(); app.json icon/adaptiveIcon/favicon/splash paths all resolve to real PNGs. Health endpoints: GET /health, HEAD /health, and GET /api/health all return 200 with {"status":"ok"} on localhost:8001; GET /api/health via public ingress URL also 200 with no auth required. Account deletion: created a scratch user directly in Mongo, they created a trip + flight, accepted a collab invite onto the seed trip; DELETE /api/auth/me returned 200 and cascaded — scratch trip gone, scratch flight gone, scratch session revoked (GET /auth/me → 401), scratch user removed from seed trip's collaborators, seed trip untouched (name/destination/user_id/share_id all preserved), seed trip flights identical (same ids/count), users row for scratch user deleted, seed token demo_marketing_token_12345 still authenticates. DELETE without auth → 401. Regression: partial PATCH on flight only mutates notes; documents POST returns size, LIST strips file_base64 (empty string, size>0), single GET returns full blob; invite creation + public preview (no auth) returns expired=false + trip_name.
action_items: Optional cleanup: 10 sibling <name>.png.jpg-source backup files in /app/frontend/assets/{images,marketing}/ are the original malformed JPEG payloads. Expo shouldn't bundle them (no .png extension), but they add ~5 MB to git — safe to delete once you're confident the fix sticks.
Non-blocking (still open from Round 4): update_trip PATCH is open to collaborators (rename etc). Decide if collaborators may edit trip metadata or if this should be owner_only.

Non-blocking: cascade_delete_trip is called by DELETE /auth/me, but if it ever fails mid-loop the trip row will already be deleted-by-user_id afterwards — behaviour is fine, but if it must be atomic wrap in a Mongo transaction.
critical_code_review_comments: PNGs re-encoded with Pillow are true PNGs (RGBA, no exotic chunks); AAPT will accept them on the next EAS Android build. Backup .jpg-source files use a non-.png extension so they won't be picked up by @drawable resource compilation.

delete_account handler order is correct: cascade sub-items -> delete trips -> pull user from other trips' collaborators -> delete invites they created -> delete sessions -> delete users row. No orphans possible.
Root-level /health uses app.api_route with methods=[GET,HEAD] which correctly exposes both verbs; /api/health only exposes GET (fine — probes commonly use GET on /api paths).
help.tsx delete button was not exercised (frontend testing skipped per request); verified only the backend endpoint it calls.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data added. Scratch users/trips/flights created inside tests are cleaned up in fixture teardown or in the finally block of test_delete_me_cascade. The seed user_demo_marketing + trip 9fbdeac7-a11c-4be2-a448-9c8560a1b6ad + Bearer demo_marketing_token_12345 were NOT modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round 6 covered the deployment blocker fixes (PNG validity, /health, DELETE /auth/me). backend_round6_test.py is stable and reusable; on the flight PATCH regression the Flight model uses departure_location/arrival_location/cost_currency (not origin/destination/currency) — remember when writing similar tests. Seed integrity checks compare snapshot fields BEFORE the destructive test runs (see seed_baseline fixture pattern).
rca_of_issue: N/A — this was a verification-of-fix pass, not a bug hunt. The original AAPT compile failure ('file failed to compile' on drawable-mdpi PNGs) was correctly root-caused: all supposed PNGs in /app/frontend/assets/ had JPEG headers (ff d8 ff e0) but .png extensions, so AAPT's PNG parser rejected them. Fix by re-encoding through Pillow with format='PNG' produces canonical 89 50 4e 47 signatures which AAPT accepts.
